purpose: Holdout and dev inputs for the seven non-LinkedIn styles. The bathroom sentence is dev-only and must not appear in style prompts. Few-shot sources must not copy these sentences.

sentences.text: I missed the bus this morning.
I took a massive dump just now
I burned the toast and the smoke alarm rang for 3 minutes.
I tripped on a flat sidewalk in front of 12 people.
I spent $47 on a taxi to avoid a 10-minute walk.
I told my manager the deck was finished when it was still an outline.
I forgot my friend's birthday and texted them at 11:58 p.m.
I think pineapple belongs on pizza and I will not apologize.
The office coffee tastes like a wet coin and nobody else will say it.
I waved back at someone who was waving at the person behind me.
I finished the 10-kilometer race in 58 minutes and then lay on the grass.
If my cat ran the city, the buses would stop for naps.
I reheated fish in the office microwave on March 3 at 11:40.
I cried in a stall after a meeting that lasted 90 minutes.
I got the promotion and immediately worried I would be bad at it.
My date ordered for me, and I ate the salad I did not want.
The printer jammed on page 2 of 14 and I kicked it once.
I pretended to laugh at a joke I did not understand.
I left my laptop on the train and it came back the next day.
I have been stuck on the same email since Tuesday.
I slept through my 7:30 alarm and joined the call from bed.
What if the moon were made of cheese and I still had a 9 a.m. meeting?
On April 2 I missed a 9:15 dentist appointment and paid a $25 fee.
